summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that Cat Lake First Nation and Lac Seul First Nation authorized the Springpole Gold Project following an Anishnaabe Led Impact Assessment, conditional on a term sheet with 35 negotiated terms including environmental protections, cultural safeguards, economic participation, and community healing. No financial terms, share price, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. This is a project permitting milestone, not a special situation transaction. The filing is a routine current report of foreign private issuer disclosing a development in project authorization.
